scope: Independent implementation backlog; baseline statuses describe 630e090, with later implementation progress recorded separately in implementation-progress.md.

tickets.title: Resolve video visual coverage
tickets.baseline_status: Acquisition resolved; sampled visual pass complete for all 13 sources
tickets.implementation: Use acquired originals for denser inspection of brief transitions and exact controls when implementing each feature. All supplied two-second samples have been reviewed; continuous frame-by-frame parity is not claimed.
tickets.acceptance: Every source has a frame-review record or remains explicitly blocked.
tickets.implementation_progress: All 107 storyboards individually inspected, full AV decoding and complete-track ASR review added; direct continuous audiovisual playback remains incomplete.

tickets.title: Dashboard information architecture
tickets.implementation: Add project/target/campaign/finding totals, severity proportions, duration-aware history and risky-target rows. Keep the fork’s evidence-first semantics.
tickets.acceptance: Zero-data and multi-project totals match records; risky rows navigate to the exact target/campaign.

tickets.title: Consistent design system
tickets.implementation: Create shared page-header, stat-card, badge, table-toolbar, detail-section and form-section components using repo-native CSS. Maintain responsive keyboard-accessible navigation. At the reference viewport, the graph uses about 940 px and the inspector 340 px; adapt rather than hard-code this split. Keep the lower-left tour card clear of navigation and support a mobile inspector sheet.
tickets.acceptance: Readable at 390 and 1440 px; focus visible; active sidebar state and severity text do not rely on color alone.
tickets.evidence: Published screenshots; implementation proposal; A: 1280×720 graph reference
tickets.implementation_progress: Desktop map tour overlay, mobile inspector sheet and readable finding cards implemented and visually inspected at 1440 and 390 px. Broader consistency and exact visual parity remain partial.

tickets.title: First-use onboarding
tickets.implementation: Add first-account setup using the private recovery token; prompt for a strong password and offer model/runtime readiness checks. Preserve OIDC and recovery access. Do not add vendor license checks.
tickets.acceptance: Concurrent setup creates one initial administrator; account data are never public; reload does not expose recovery credentials.
tickets.implementation_progress: Guided initial administrator setup via private recovery token, atomic single-user creation, password confirmation and provider-settings handoff implemented; concurrency and authorization tested. OIDC/recovery remain supported.

tickets.title: Campaign launch completion
tickets.implementation: Preserve presets, native flag preview and vault references. Add distinct program vs schedule/display names, attack-strategy explanations and explicit remediation prerequisite status.
tickets.acceptance: Rendered preview equals validated launch scope; severity cap remains distinct from integration failure thresholds.

tickets.title: Live run console
tickets.implementation: Promote run output to a dedicated campaign view with connection status, reconnect/resume position, bounded history and a cancel action whose scope is accurately stated.
tickets.acceptance: Reconnect loses no retained output and does not duplicate it; launcher exit and assessment finalization remain separate statuses.

tickets.title: Finding search, filters and sort
tickets.implementation: Add severity/status/category/campaign/target filters plus stable sorting and pagination or virtualization. Preserve selections in navigation URLs.
tickets.acceptance: Stable ordering for ties; filters compose; empty results clear correctly; large datasets remain usable.
tickets.implementation_progress: Composed filters, metadata search, deterministic sorting, bounded pages, keyboard finding buttons and URL/history/reload persistence implemented. Optional REST paging preserves safe projection and unlimited legacy requests. 20k-record boundary cases and desktop/mobile browser flows tested; snapshot transfer is not streamed. See finding-navigation.md.

tickets.title: Finding detail and fix linkage
tickets.implementation: Add explicit impact, CVSS vector, related asset, remediation disposition and links to local proposal or recorded forge PR. Keep raw HTTP evidence and normalized reading views.
tickets.acceptance: Only a finding’s own campaign/proposal is linked; absent impact/PR data show unknown or unavailable, never fabricated content.

tickets.title: Default redaction and controlled reveal
tickets.implementation: Define a server-side redacted projection for findings, reports and logs. Add role-checked, explicit local reveal and expiry/audit behavior. Full raw response data must not already be in a supposedly redacted response.
tickets.acceptance: Secret sentinels absent from default HTTP responses, SSE, DOM and client logs; reveal requires authorization and is revoked on lock.

tickets.title: Report review experience
tickets.implementation: Add executive/technical navigation, findings anchors, impact and remediation roadmap. Keep export formats consistent with stored evidence and distinguish unsigned, signed and encrypted outputs.
tickets.acceptance: Navigation reaches correct finding; long HTTP evidence wraps; signature/encryption validated independently; no unrecorded findings appear.
tickets.implementation_progress: Keyboard section/finding-heading navigation implemented in report preview; roadmap and further evidence/export refinements remain partial.

tickets.title: Asset-to-finding-to-proposal navigation
tickets.implementation: Make graph selection reveal asset identity, risk, measured connections, related findings and their proposals. Navigation must preserve campaign context. Add a closeable asset inspector with severity totals and finding rows (severity, CVSS, title/category, proposal indicator); selecting a finding opens its detail with Back, endpoint, MITRE, description, remediation, proposal and full-report actions.
tickets.acceptance: Selecting an asset yields exactly its node-linked findings; missing node linkage is displayed separately. Back restores the selected asset/list context; close and keyboard focus behave predictably; proposal/report links resolve to the selected finding and campaign, and unavailable actions explain their state.
tickets.implementation_progress: Asset summaries/severity cards, in-panel finding detail/Back, real proposal indicators and campaign-preserving report/proposal review implemented. Current linkage, deleted findings and response races tested. Broader finding detail/report acceptance remains tracked in F02/R01.

tickets.title: Evidence-backed attack-path tours
tickets.implementation: Introduce persisted observed path records with ordered node/edge references and evidence IDs. Add stepwise playback. Keep current finding-location tour separate when no verified path exists. Present a numbered tour card with Back/Next, step indicators, Technical details where relevant, and Explore freely. Reframe the camera with reduced-motion support. Steps 3/4 are now observed as database access and exposed files; derive actual steps from campaign evidence and do not treat illustrative topology as an observed attack path.
tickets.acceptance: Unconnected nodes never become a kill chain; each tour step resolves to supporting evidence; invalid paths are rejected. Card, graph selection and inspector remain usable together; keyboard can move between steps and return to free exploration; reduced motion disables animated reframing.
tickets.evidence: Pro 01:55–02:18; A: infra-orbital.gif sampled frames across 0–181, only tour steps 1/4 and 2/4 observed; V: Pro tour 120s database step 3, 128s file exposure step 4, Finish action
tickets.implementation_progress: Persisted operator-reviewed directed paths, same-campaign node/finding/evidence validation, evidence fingerprints, stale-reference blocking, create/delete UI and accessible step playback implemented and tested. Camera reframes instantly. Automated exploit verification, editing/history and headset playback remain open; see recorded-paths.md.

tickets.title: Immersive graph parity
tickets.implementation: Retain WebXR capability detection and provide keyboard/non-XR alternatives. Schedule headset testing of picking, locomotion, exit and labels; do not infer exact controls from unavailable video frames.
tickets.acceptance: Unsupported devices degrade gracefully; headset test evidence is required before claiming immersive parity.
tickets.evidence: Pro graph narration; precise VR interactions unverified

tickets.title: Calendar scheduling and editing
tickets.implementation: Add edit/duplicate/preview, one-time and calendar recurrence, every-N periods, named timezone and run history. Migrate existing interval schedules without changing their meaning.
tickets.acceptance: DST transition cases and monthly boundaries tested; pausing/deleting cannot resurrect schedules; concurrent edits preserve versioned state.

tickets.title: Remediation review workspace
tickets.implementation: Show branch/base, patch, scope judge, before/after checks, attempts, disposition and finding links. Describe local validation separately from deployed-target verification.
tickets.acceptance: Unreproduced/rejected/failed states remain visible; a validated local proposal never silently marks the target fixed.

tickets.title: Operator-controlled publication UI
tickets.implementation: If later requested, build a reviewable plan panel around the existing gated forge adapter. Bind approval to exact patch/destination/base; expose recorded PR read-only afterward.
tickets.acceptance: Tests use fake transports; no automatic push, PR or merge; explicit future operator authorization required for real publication.

tickets.title: Integration connection wizard
tickets.implementation: Provide installation-specific URL, auth method, connectivity test, role/scopes, transport choice and safe template downloads. Keep credentials out of exported workflow JSON.
tickets.acceptance: No secret embedded in generated templates; localhost/container-network mistakes produce actionable errors; tests do not send external messages.

tickets.title: n8n end-to-end verification
tickets.implementation: Validate campaign launch/wait, findings, report, retest, metrics and event-trigger handling in a disposable n8n instance. Connect finding outcomes to safe downstream mappings.
tickets.acceptance: Persisted replay suppression and HMAC freshness tested across restart; no Slack/Jira/DefectDojo traffic without explicit configuration.
tickets.implementation_progress: Actual n8n 2.45.4 workflow engine and editor credential-test API verified locally and in CI. Authenticated token/password tests fixed; trigger restart/poll/webhook lifecycle remains open.

tickets.title: GitHub CI experience
tickets.implementation: Exercise configurable severity gates, summary tables, SARIF and artifacts against a disposable test workflow. Provide a copyable setup recipe in the WebUI.
tickets.acceptance: Gate is recomputed from findings; infrastructure failure differs from a security-policy failure; reports contain safe fields.

tickets.title: GitLab report contract
tickets.implementation: Validate component inputs, threshold defaults, Code Quality/SAST exports and merge-request result mapping. Provide a setup recipe without trying to merge anything.
tickets.acceptance: Report schemas and gate exit behavior match the pinned integration version; no external merge action.

tickets.title: Jenkins failure vs unstable policy
tickets.implementation: Build/test HPI, pipeline step, separate fail/unstable policies, Warnings-NG publication and archived reports in an isolated Jenkins host.
tickets.acceptance: Threshold precedence and zero-findings behavior verified; a scanner error cannot masquerade as a clean scan.

tickets.title: IDE data and reveal parity
tickets.implementation: Validate data-directory and fixture modes, campaign tree, search/filter/sort and redacted detail panels in actual VS Code and JetBrains hosts.
tickets.acceptance: Local reveal is explicit and authorized; remote workspaces cannot silently enable it; no real evidence is copied into fixture previews.

tickets.title: Posture dashboard and metric definitions
tickets.implementation: Add exploited/confirmed counts, target risk, remediation disposition rates and MITRE breakdown with documented denominators and drill-down. Validate Grafana datasource/plugin separately.
tickets.acceptance: Rates have explicit cohorts and time windows; no local-validation rate is called deployed remediation; metadata feeds exclude evidence and report bodies.

tickets.title: Splunk SOC flow
tickets.implementation: Validate HEC ingestion, safe-field search dashboards, target/status/severity filters, MITRE aggregation and an authorized retest action.
tickets.acceptance: No evidence/secrets in HEC payloads; retest preserves original exclusions and authorization boundaries.

tickets.title: SDK / CLI compatibility matrix
tickets.implementation: Retest current and vendored clients against this fork, edition detection, summary/list operations, nullable evidence and severity-gate exit contracts.
tickets.acceptance: Document supported versions; auth expiry, malformed responses and interrupted runs fail explicitly rather than reporting success.

tickets.title: Deployment and readiness workspace
tickets.implementation: Add cloud plan preview, instance requirements, progress/status and diagnostics results. Retain local model/provider selection and operator-owned integrity controls.
tickets.acceptance: No cloud resources or firewall changes on preview; never reuse vendor activation; deployment execution remains separately authorized.
